hebrewText: בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֡מָּה רָאִ֣יתִי בִֽ/יהוּדָ֣ה דֹּֽרְכִֽים גִּתּ֣וֹת בַּ/שַּׁבָּ֡ת וּ/מְבִיאִ֣ים הָ/עֲרֵמ֣וֹת וְֽ/עֹמְסִ֪ים עַל הַ/חֲמֹרִ֟ים וְ/אַף יַ֜יִן עֲנָבִ֤ים וּ/תְאֵנִים֙ וְ/כָל מַשָּׂ֔א וּ/מְבִיאִ֥ים יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּ/י֣וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֑ת וָ/אָעִ֕יד בְּ/י֖וֹם מִכְרָ֥/ם צָֽיִד

tokens.bdb: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
tokens.kjv: age, [phrase] always, [phrase] chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), [phrase] elder, [idiom] end, [phrase] evening, [phrase] (for) ever(-lasting, -more), [idiom] full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now, [phrase] old, [phrase] outlived, [phrase] perpetually, presently, [phrase] remaineth, [idiom] required, season, [idiom] since, space, then, (process of) time, [phrase] as at other times, [phrase] in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), [idiom] whole ([phrase] age), (full) year(-ly), [phrase] younger.
tokens.explanation: yom — dia, período de luz, era, tempo específico

tokens.bdb: they (only used when emphatic)
tokens.kjv: it, like, [idiom] (how, so) many (soever, more as) they (be), (the) same, [idiom] so, [idiom] such, their, them, these, they, those, which, who, whom, withal, ye.

tokens.bdb: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
tokens.kjv: advise self, appear, approve, behold, [idiom] certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy, have experience, gaze, take heed, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] joyfully, lo, look (on, one another, one on another, one upon another, out, up, upon), mark, meet, [idiom] be near, perceive, present, provide, regard, (have) respect, (fore-, cause to, let) see(-r, -m, one another), shew (self), [idiom] sight of others, (e-) spy, stare, [idiom] surely, [idiom] think, view, visions.
tokens.explanation: raah — ver, observar, contemplar, perceber, entender

tokens.bdb: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
tokens.kjv: Judah.
tokens.explanation: Yehudah — Judá, quarto filho de Jacó, tribo e reino

tokens.bdb: to tread; by implication, to walk; also to string abow (by treading on it in bending)
tokens.kjv: archer, bend, come, draw, go (over), guide, lead (forth), thresh, tread (down), walk.

tokens.bdb: a wine-press (or vat for holding the grapes in pressing them)
tokens.kjv: (wine-) press (fat).

tokens.bdb: intermission, i.e (specifically) the Sabbath
tokens.kjv: ([phrase] every) sabbath.

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.
tokens.explanation: bo — vir, ir, entrar, chegar, avançar em direção a algo

tokens.bdb: a heap; specifically, a sheaf
tokens.kjv: heap (of corn), sheaf.

tokens.bdb: to load, i.e. impose aburden (or figuratively, infliction)
tokens.kjv: be borne, (heavy) burden (self), lade, load, put.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: a male ass (from its dun red)
tokens.kjv: (he) ass.

tokens.bdb: meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.kjv: also, [phrase] although, and (furthermore, yet), but, even, [phrase] how much less (more, rather than), moreover, with, yea.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.enLiteralWord: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.explanation: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.explanationEn: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though

tokens.bdb: wine (as fermented); by implication, intoxication
tokens.kjv: banqueting, wine, wine(-bibber).

tokens.bdb: a grape
tokens.kjv: (ripe) grape, wine.

tokens.bdb: the fig (tree or fruit)
tokens.kjv: fig (tree).

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: a burden; specifically, tribute, or (abstractly) porterage; figuratively, an utterance, chiefly adoom, especially singing; mental, desire
tokens.kjv: burden, carry away, prophecy, [idiom] they set, song, tribute.

tokens.bdb: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
tokens.kjv: Jerusalem.

tokens.kjv: ([phrase] every) sabbath.

tokens.bdb: to duplicate or repeat; by implication, to protest, testify (as by reiteration); intensively, to encompass, restore (as a sort of reduplication)
tokens.kjv: admonish, charge, earnestly, lift up, protest, call (take) to record, relieve, rob, solemnly, stand upright, testify, give warning, (bear, call to, give, take to) witness.

tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, sell (away, -er, self).

tokens.bdb: the chase; also game (thus taken); (generally) lunch (especially for a journey)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] catcheth, food, [idiom] hunter, (that which he took in) hunting, venison, victuals.
